exceptionPolicy: Never silently swallow WHEN OTHERS. At the application boundary, record SQLCODE, SQLERRM and DBMS_UTILITY.FORMAT_ERROR_BACKTRACE with app_log.error, then re-raise with RAISE. Do not commit or roll back the caller's transaction in reusable routines; document expected exceptions explicitly.
